fields.title: Pioneering the Next Era of
fields.paragraph1:
The International Conference on Global Innovation and Technology brings together leading academic scientists, researchers, and scholars to exchange and share their experiences and research results on all aspects of Technology and Innovation.

It also provides a premier interdisciplinary platform for researchers, practitioners, and educators to present and discuss the most recent innovations, trends, and concerns as well as practical challenges encountered.
